text:
sam: Heads-upKaleidoCompute wants a short joint benchmark package for the marketplace tile focused on perf/W and a reproducibility bundle. They also asked for a muted co-announcement.

marta: Quick checklist proposal so everyone is aligned:
- model: redwood-10b (fp16)
- context: 512 tokens, KV cache preheated
- runs: 3 steady runs, steady window = 300s after warmup
- measurement: wall watts from PDU (sum legs), report mean and stddev
- include: raw CSVs, kernel commit hash, config.yaml, 16:9 hero image

jing: From infra: we need the kernel patch (stride-prefetch-lite) in a release build to be fair. In our lab that patch gave ~6-9% perf/W uplift. I'll open the PR and add the smoke command.

jing: ```
# reproducible smoke command
./bench_tool --model=redwood-10b --seq=512 --warmup=180 --steady=300 \
  --runs=3 --collect=tokens_per_s,p99_latency,pdu_watts --kernel=stride-prefetch-lite \
  --out=artifacts/kaleido-3run.csv
```

kaleido-eng: We'll join the cross-org call Tue 11am PT and provide rack spec + hero image. Important: our PDUs report wall watts and we use a 3-phase feed; we'll include wiring notes. Also want the artifact bundle before we co-sign numbers.

kai: Proposed acceptance thresholds for the marketplace tile (strict):
- sustained tokens/s >= 10k per rack
- perf/W >= 11.8 tokens/s/W (mean across 3 runs)
- p99 <= 290ms at 512 context
If any metric misses but kernel shows a consistent uplift vs baseline, we can note "kernel tuning improves efficiency" in the blog but not in the tile.

marta: Legal will need to review the co-announcement text. ops-bot, can you open a ticket?

ops-bot: Created ticket LEGAL-1007. Estimated turnaround: 48h. Calendar invite sent for Tue 11am PT cross-org call.

jing: I'll run 3x sweeps on Rack-Z tomorrow AM and paste CSVs + a short mean/std table here by 3pm PT. If we hit the thresholds I will tag the kernel commit hash and assemble the artifact bundle.

kaleido-eng: Also provide cooling notes: CRAC setpoint and fan curve. We'll add our rack thermal diagram to the artifact bundle so readers know the context.

sam: Marketing wants a conservative one-line for the tile; blog can expand with kernel details and the exact smoke command. Good to keep both separate.

marta: Action items:
- jing: open PR for stride-prefetch-lite + run 3x sweeps and post CSVs (due: tomorrow 3pm PT)
- kaleido-eng: provide rack spec + hero image (due: Mon EOD)
- ops-bot: legal ticket + call invite (done)
- sam: hold tile copy until legal signoff (in progress)

kai: If the runs narrowly miss perf/W but show consistent uplift, consider doing a short follow-up test with slightly different warmup lengths and report that as an "engineering update" in the blog. Tile stays conservative.

jing: Copy. Pasting preview numbers after the morning sweep. Will include raw CSVs and a reproducibility.md with exact KV-cache preload steps.

kaleido-eng: We'll be on the Tue call to co-verify. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
